[RFCS.4.1] A **lean** trace file must begin with a `StreamHeader` atom. A
**self-contained** trace file ([RFCS.13]) begins with its embedded DSC — a
`DscHeader` atom — with the `StreamHeader` atom following the DSC front. A reader
must dispatch on the leading atom ([RFCS.13.3]): `StreamHeader` first → lean;
`DscHeader` first → self-contained (process the embedded DSC front, then the
event trace). A reader must reject a file that begins with neither
`StreamHeader` nor `DscHeader`. In the self-contained case the leading DSC atoms are
the embedded program and are processed as such, not skipped — the
unknown-atom skip rule ([RFCS.2.3]) applies only to unrecognised atoms
**within** the trace body, never to the DSC front.
